protocol.title: Accurate Processing of Ultra-Short Immune Signals by Single Macrophages
protocol.platform: Multilayer PDMS microfluidic live-cell stimulation device with pneumatic valve control
protocol.cell_type: Primary bone-marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs) from mVenus-RelA (RelA^V/V) C57BL/6J transgenic mice
protocol.objective: Short-pulse stimulation (1-second) of primary macrophages with five NF-kB ligands and single-cell time-lapse tracking of NF-kB nuclear translocation dynamics via mVenus-RelA fluorescence reporter

device.type: Multilayer PDMS microfluidic culture and stimulation chip
device.fabrication: Silicon wafer master molds; 10:1 PDMS monomer:catalyst (Momentive); control and fluid layers spin-coated and bonded by oxygen plasma; overnight bake; inlets punched; glass-bonded
layers: Fluid layer (PDMS, culture chambers and flow channels)
device.culture_chamber_pretreatment: 0.2 mg/mL fibronectin solution (Sigma-Aldrich) in PBS; incubated before cell seeding

flow_control.valve_type: Pneumatic; electronically controlled via MATLAB GUI

device.environmental_control: In-situ microbiome box; maintains 37 C, humidity, and CO2 throughout imaging

mouse_model.housing: Specific pathogen-free conditions, University of Chicago
mouse_model.ethics: Approved by University of Chicago IACUC; NIH Guide for Care and Use of Laboratory Animals

differentiation_cytokine.name: Murine m-CSF
differentiation_cytokine.preparation: Reconstituted in ultrapure water; aliquoted and stored at -80 C

TNFalpha.storage: -80 C stock; diluted in complete RPMI on ice

LipidA.full_name: Ultrapure Lipid A from E. coli O111:B4
LipidA.storage: -80 C stock; diluted in complete RPMI on ice

Pam2CSK4.pathway: TLR2/6; extracellular bacterial lipopeptide sensing via MyD88/TIRAP
Pam2CSK4.notes: Induces stable TLR2/TLR6 m-shape heterodimer via strong hydrogen bonds with peptide chains; highest NF-kB amplitude and CC_max under 1-second pulse
Pam2CSK4.storage: -80 C stock; diluted in complete RPMI on ice

R848_Resiquimod.pathway: TLR7; endosomal receptor-mediated viral RNA sensing via MyD88
R848_Resiquimod.signal_type: Viral pathogen-associated molecular pattern (PAMP); small molecule
R848_Resiquimod.notes: Intracellular endosomal receptor; exhibits all-or-nothing activation dynamic under dose-duration tradeoff
R848_Resiquimod.storage: -80 C stock; diluted in complete RPMI on ice

CpG_ODN1668.pathway: TLR9; endosomal receptor-mediated foreign DNA sensing
CpG_ODN1668.notes: Lowest pairwise mutual information vs TNF (MI = 0) under 1-second pulse; cells do not distinguish CpG from TNF at 1-second duration
CpG_ODN1668.storage: -80 C stock; diluted in complete RPMI on ice

steps.name: BMDM isolation and differentiation
steps.notes: Bone marrow flushed from tibias and femurs of 6-12-week-old male and female RelA^V/V mice; resuspended in complete RPMI supplemented with 20 ng/mL m-CSF; BMDMs harvested on days 7-9 (encoded as 9 days = 12960 min)

steps.name: Microfluidic device fibronectin priming
steps.notes: Chambers pre-incubated with fibronectin in PBS to promote BMDM adhesion; mix abstracts channel-flow coating step

steps.name: BMDM seeding and equilibration
steps.notes: BMDMs left unperturbed 4-6 h until attached and equilibrated in microfluidic chambers (encoded as 6 h = 360 min)

steps.name: Nuclear tracking stain
steps.notes: 1 uM Hoechst 33342 in phenol red-free RPMI per producer instructions; enables nuclear segmentation (395 nm channel) and cell tracking throughout 6-hour time-lapse

steps.name: TNF alpha 1-second pulse stimulation
steps.operation: mix (abstracts 1-second pneumatic valve pulse at 4 psi)
steps.notes: Models intracellular cytokine communication; weakest response under 1-second pulse; some cells display persistent NF-kB oscillations despite brief exposure

steps.name: Lipid A 1-second pulse stimulation
steps.operation: mix (abstracts 1-second pneumatic valve pulse at 4 psi)
steps.notes: Largest proportion of late responders (~30%) and longest average time to peak (>50 min); most potent under persistent stimulation but not under 1-second pulse

steps.name: Pam2CSK4 1-second pulse stimulation
steps.operation: mix (abstracts 1-second pneumatic valve pulse at 4 psi)
steps.notes: Strongest response under 1-second pulse; highest early AUC, amplitude, speed, and duration; CC_max = 0.82; lowest late responder fraction (~3%); QC reference condition

steps.name: R848 1-second pulse stimulation
steps.operation: mix (abstracts 1-second pneumatic valve pulse at 4 psi)
steps.notes: Endosomal receptor; all-or-nothing activation dynamic; largest channel capacity under dose-duration tradeoff experiment; lower doses elicit minimal to null response

steps.name: CpG ODN 1668 1-second pulse stimulation
steps.operation: mix (abstracts 1-second pneumatic valve pulse at 4 psi)
steps.notes: Endosomal receptor; CpG and TNF induce highest oscillatory frequencies; pairwise MI vs TNF = 0 (indistinguishable under 1-second pulse)

steps.name: Time-lapse NF-kB live-cell imaging and detection
steps.activation_threshold: 2 standard deviations above mean nuclear/cytoplasmic ratio of unstimulated cells
steps.analysis_software: Custom MATLAB 2024a image processing; nuclear segmentation via Hoechst; nuclear/cytoplasmic mVenus-RelA ratio per cell per frame; death/dividing/out-of-focus cells removed; >99% tracking accuracy

nfkb_dynamic_features.description: 8 dynamic features extracted from single-cell NF-kB traces (MATLAB 2024a)

features.name: Early AUC
features.definition: Area under NF-kB trace from 0-45 min (trapz)

features.name: Late AUC
features.definition: Area under NF-kB trace from 45-240 min (trapz)

features.name: Speed
features.definition: Maximum rate of change of NF-kB level over time (diff)

features.name: Duration
features.definition: Time NF-kB level remains above activation threshold

features.name: Oscillations
features.definition: First harmonic of FFT of NF-kB trace

features.name: Activation Time
features.definition: First passage time of NF-kB above activation threshold

features.name: Time to Peak
features.definition: Time elapsed from stimulation to maximum NF-kB peak (findpeaks)

single_cell_subpopulations.method: k-means clustering (MATLAB; 10 random centroid replicates; Euclidean distance) on activation time and amplitude
single_cell_subpopulations.paracrine_signaling: No correlation found between late responder activation time and distance to nearest early responder (r^2 ~ 0); late response is intrinsic to NF-kB pathway

channel_capacity_1s_pulse.time_of_CC_max: ~21 min (coincides with Pam2CSK4 peak NF-kB translocation)
channel_capacity_1s_pulse.conclusion: Short-pulse specificity comparable to persistent stimulation

mathematical_model.description: Minimal ODE model of ligand-receptor interaction and NF-kB signal transduction

activation_modes.m1: Monotonic increase: NF-kB strength increases with pulse duration
activation_modes.m2: Non-monotonic: intermediate peak with variable pulse duration
activation_modes.m3: Monotonic decrease: NF-kB strength decreases with pulse duration (high dose filter)

mathematical_model.key_parameter: Hill coefficient n (cooperativity between active receptors; highest MRMR predictor score)

noise_sources.extrinsic: Receptor expression variability (Gamma distribution; TNFR Gamma(4.32,1035), TLR2 Gamma(2.23,4914), TLR7 Gamma(4.80,4404))
noise_sources.intrinsic: Stochastic fluctuation of kinetic rates (kc for TNF; Hill coefficient n for Pam; half-max activation K for R848)

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.description: BMDM prep, device priming, cell seeding, nuclear staining, five 1-second ligand pulses, imaging pool merge, live-cell imaging heat, NF-kB detect

key_constraints_observed: Duration tokens s and m only; no h token
No variable reassignment; distinct names for all intermediate merge variables (imagingPool_ab, imagingPool_abc, imagingPool_abcd, imagingPool_all)
dispense restricted to declared manifest entries only
No loop constructs; all five ligand arms encoded as sequential independent mix calls
equilibratedBMDMs used as input to five independent mix calls (compiler accepts; models parallel chamber architecture)

bioscript_compiler_notes.scope_note: Five ligand stimulation conditions (TNF, Lipid A, Pam2CSK4, R848, CpG) run in parallel across separate microfluidic chambers on the same chip in the physical experiment; encoded sequentially in BioScript as per compiler requirements. imagingPool_all merge chain abstracts the single Nikon Ti2 field-of-view imaging all five chambers during the 6-hour time-lapse run.
